notes.title: Patch 1 - Out Now I Thalassa: Edge of the Abyss
notes.notes:
Hey all! 👋 Today, we have rolled out Patch 1 for Thalassa: Edge of the Abyss. Our first patch contains adjustments to Thalassa's audio mix, fixes to a handful of community-reported bugs and more!

Since our launch, we have been listening to community feedback surrounding voice over audio levels and audio balancing. With Patch 1, we've implemented multiple adjustments and improvements towards the audio in Thalassa: Edge of the Abyss.

We hope this patch makes for a more enjoyable journey in the deep! 🌊

🛠️ Patch 1 - Patch Notes
Adjustments
 Multiple enhancements to the audio mix, including:


 An increase in the volume of voice overs and music, for audio balancing.
 Lowering the muffled effect on several voice lines.
 Lowering of the conclusion sound effect during mystery solving.
 Smoothing dialogue lines to remove audio jumps during specific dialogue.
 Adjustments to dialogue to remove audio stutters during scenes with Alex.
 Adjustments to Kadri’s signing to prevent dialogue overlaps and incorrect timings.
 Other audio balances and improvements.
 Localisation adjustments, including:

 Adding updated Norwegian translations.
 Adjustments to the naming of ‘Expedition Display’ in Russian localisation.
 Other localisation adjustments.

 Secret visuals added near the cradle.
 Adjustments to the outside area near Thomas’ cabin with a vertical beam barrier added.
 Updated credits.
Fixes
 Visual optimisations during Bailey’s boat scenes.
 Implementation of a backup restore for the Master Key item in case the game saved after this item was lost.
 Fixed an audio reverb issue for specific voice lines during two separate scenes, one with Maria & Isabel and one with Erik & Kaymar.
 Fixed an issue where a voice line for Alex would be occasionally missing.
 Fixed an issue with Thomas & Erik’s voice lines to prevent occasional audio duplication.
We'd also like to thank the community for your continued support! We hope you enjoy the fixes in Patch 1 and your playthrough of Thalassa: Edge of the Abyss. ⚓

notes.title: Release date moves to 1st August I Thalassa: Edge of the Abyss
notes.notes:
Hey all,

We’ve made the decision to move the release date for Thalassa: Edge of the Abyss to 1st August 2024.﻿

To our community- we want to apologise for this delay. This decision certainly was not an easy one to make.
 
You'll still be able to delve into the deep with Thalassa during Steam Next Fest, and we sincerely hope you enjoy your first voyage with our demo.
﻿
We understand this is not the news you want to hear, but we hope you’ll continue to follow our journey during Steam Next Fest and towards our new 1st August launch date. We cannot wait for you to experience this immersive and atmospheric story soon.
